approach: CR-7 doctrine KEEP (retro plan, 7-CR queue; source sdd strategy.2d9bbc seq2 item 2, distilled from 263-op6-m4-persona-voice-dimension where the defect recurred to fourth order across five judge rounds): a whole-output untradeable behavior is one boolean @quality scenario, never a @rubric dimension — the gate requires every scenario to pass, so the boolean is strictly stronger than a dimension that can be zeroed and bought back on unrelated points.

Gap identified in explore reconnaissance: the standing Selection bar bans untradeable criteria but its ACED discriminator is same-object and scoped by an 'only' — fail a dimension only when a boolean scenario in the same suite decides that exact property. With no boolean twin present the test cannot fire and the 'only' licenses the defect. The new whole-output test is a second, disjoint entry point beside same-object, read on a SINGLE dimension (does its criterion span the whole output?), never as a comparison between two dimensions — so it does not reintroduce the twin-scan SDD #280 rejected.

Form is already legal and needs no new vocabulary: @quality names the result axis and @rubric is the orthogonal assertion form, so a boolean @quality scenario is Form 1 under sdd:suite-format-governance. CR-7 codifies WHEN to choose it, coining nothing.

Placement: criteria into the aced-builder-spec bar (reference node, no .feature) plus additive scenarios on the scenario-writer producer node and the spec-validator judge node — the corpus pattern every existing Selection criterion follows. The judge node is a scope expansion beyond the brief's two named targets and is flagged for Council at the gate.
In-session conductor: judges cold, synchronous and self-observed with no verdict relayed; gates self-asserted by:agent to this shard, then STOP for Council ratification (by:name) and merge.

judge: aced-spec-validator (cold, synchronous, self-observed; two independent rounds, round 2 a fresh cold judge re-deriving its own oracle rather than the round-1 agent continued)

why.floor: none — the spec-gate structural classifier reports ADDITIVE on both suites (2 added / 0 modified / 0 removed each). No frozen scenario narrowed or rewritten, so no Clearance floor and no re-open; both suites self-clear and keep their @frozen tag. Root status and approval frontmatter untouched; check-spec-state reports spec states OK.
why.blast: small — 4 additive boolean scenarios across two partial-fit role nodes in one project spec (scenario-writer producer, spec-validator judge), plus their README Use Cases / Control Flow / Scenario-map surfaces. No engine, no rubric, no new vocabulary: @quality is established in the SDD glossary and suite-format tag set, orthogonal to @rubric, so the prescribed boolean @quality scenario is already legal Form 1.
why.novelty: medium — a second, disjoint entry point into Selection beside the standing same-object test. The standing bar's discriminator is scoped by an 'only' that cannot fire when no boolean twin exists, which is the persona-voice case exactly; the new ground is structural (does the criterion span the whole output?) and needs no trade judgment. Round 2 ran the new rule against the corpus it will police: the three live @quality @rubric scenarios all score per-attribute dimensions of a single artifact, so none is retroactively made non-conforming — the rule does not over-fire on the standing corpus.
why.confidence: high — round 2 ALIGNED true, 4/4 PASS, zero open markers remaining. Redundancy tested adversarially against the two nearest standing scenarios and refuted on structure, not rhetoric: the nobody-would-trade ground answers a deterministic rule by inspection, the same-object ground requires a boolean twin the new Given explicitly negates, and the CFG places the span question upstream of the substitutability branch so the grounds cannot overlap. Both negative companions confirmed non-vacuous. Pairwise consistency re-derived across both whole suites. Two judge-iteration corrections, both logged: an unscoped Then that read unconditional against a standing sibling (corrected at the Given so the positive assertion survived; round 2 verified genuine disjointness rather than a narrowed overlap), and a prose surface that stated the pass-branch relationally — the dimension-against-dimension comparison this CR names as its own anti-goal.

placement: Judge node included beyond the brief's two named targets, on the round-2 judge's concurrence: the licensing 'only' clause is judge-side text graded backward by the spec-validator, so a producer-only CR would ship a rule with a green judge still passing the defect — the fourth-order recurrence shape. Every standing Selection ground is already doubled producer-side and judge-side. Flagged for Council; droppable on its word.

why: In-session human (Council) ratification of the by:agent spec-gate self-assert. Both aced-spec-validator rounds ran cold, synchronous and self-observed, round 2 a fresh judge re-deriving its own oracle — no verdict relayed at any point, provenance intact. Round 2 ALIGNED true, 4/4 PASS, zero open markers, two judge-iteration corrections logged. Additive on both suites (2 added / 0 modified / 0 removed each), self-clearing, root status untouched. Placement scope ratified as presented: the spec-validator judge node stays in this CR. Ratified.

judge: aced-impl-judge (cold, synchronous, self-observed; no verdict relayed)

why.scenarios: 4 of 4 frozen scenarios PASS, each blind-simulated with the scenario name, Then steps and sibling scenarios withheld from the simulating context.
why.non_vacuity: Measured by ablation rather than argued. The two positive scenarios were re-run against the pre-CR configuration extracted from the prior commit, and both FAIL: the pre-CR producer authored the whole-output criterion as a @rubric with three graded dimensions, and the pre-CR judge ruled the whole-output dimension a PASS on selection while stating that the absence of a boolean twin is what CLEARS it — reproducing this CR's premise about the unbounded 'only' verbatim, and reaching for the same 'graded, holistic property is exactly what a compensatory sum is for' inference the new rule overturns. The two negative companions are correctly vacuous against a pre-CR config that had no span rule to over-fire, so the shipped evidence rests on the two positives, which is where the ablation was run.
why.anti_goal: The #280 twin-scan ban holds in all three delivered files, all phrasing the test monadically. Both blind runs on the sibling-framed Givens reached their verdict by enumerating output attributes and explicitly disclaimed dimension-to-dimension comparison, so the phrasing risk the frozen Givens carry did not convert into the banned behavior.
why.over_firing: Corpus-wide sweep of roughly 100 dimensions across every plugin in .agents/specs — not the sample named in the brief, which undercounted the live @quality @rubric scenarios at three when there are five. No dimension anywhere spans a whole output; nothing is retroactively made non-conforming.
why.integrity: Frozen suites untouched by deliver — the only .feature delta versus the spec-gate commit is the four ratified scenarios. Scope clean: no delivered file touches the frozen-rubric DocString hole, item 1 of the source ledger entry and deliberately out of scope. pnpm verify 35/35 and the aced check:spec suite re-run first-hand by the judge rather than taken on report.
why.residual: One non-blocking structural finding, recorded not fixed: in the two agent definitions the span text sits positionally after the trade text, so a top-down reader meets substitutability first. Defused rather than broken — the bar declares the grounds disjoint entry points and all three files state the ordering explicitly, and both CFGs branch span-first. Not corrected post-judgment, since editing the graded artifact after the verdict would invalidate it.

what: ACED boolean-form is scoped to UNTAGGED scenarios, while CR-7 makes a tagged @quality scenario the destination form for an untradeable criterion. A @quality scenario carrying an embedded threshold would therefore clear the boolean-form check. Pre-existing scoping, newly load-bearing.
why: Raised by the round-2 cold spec-judge. Widening it inside CR-7 would exceed the CR; it belongs to whoever owns the check's scope.

what: No boundary scenario covers whole-output-SOUNDING dimension names — coherence, clarity, overall quality on a multi-attribute artifact. A judge that over-fires only on those passes all four scenarios CR-7 froze. The disambiguator shipped in the bar text and both agent definitions; a dedicated scenario did not.
why: Raised by the round-1 cold spec-judge, which noted this defect recurred to fourth order precisely because the boundary kept migrating, making an unstated boundary the recurrence surface.

what: The Selection bar's own canonical illustrations are live violations in the corpus the bar polices. no_npx_dependency — the bar's stock example of a criterion nobody would trade, which it says belongs in a boolean Then — is a live @rubric dimension in the cyberspace write-vendor-config suite; harness_agnostic_and_mcp_free, the bar's stock double-barrel, is live in the cyberfleet pod and operator suites.
why: Surfaced by the cold impl-judge's corpus-wide sweep. Pre-existing substitutability and rubric-structure defects on the STANDING ground, neither created nor touched by CR-7 — but a bar whose own examples fail against its corpus is the recurring failure mode this repo has already named.

In-session human (Council) ratification of the by:agent impl-gate self-assert, confirmed explicitly rather than inferred from an acknowledgement. The aced-impl-judge ran cold, synchronous and self-observed with no verdict relayed — provenance intact. IMPLEMENTATION_PASS, 4/4 frozen scenarios blind-simulated, non-vacuity measured by ablation against the pre-CR config rather than argued: the pre-CR judge ruled the whole-output dimension a PASS and stated the missing boolean twin is what clears it, reproducing this CR's premise verbatim. Corpus-wide sweep of ~100 dimensions found no retroactive non-conformance. Frozen suites untouched by deliver; pnpm verify 35/35. Ratified for merge.
